news.h: Nick Bosa prepared to return Sunday
news.d: Report on Nick Bosa's status for the 49ers' upcoming game.

news.h: Nick Bosa back, Christian McCaffrey good to go for Niners
news.d: The 49ers will have a healthy Nick Bosa for the first time since Week 2, and running back Christian McCaffrey is good to go this week against the Raiders.
